newsitem.title: FRANCE: ONIC sees EU 96/97 intvn grain stocks at 5 mln T.
newsitem.headline: ONIC sees EU 96/97 intvn grain stocks at 5 mln T.

text.p: European Union intervention grain stocks are expected to rise to at least five million tonnes at the end of 1996/97 from some three million tonnes at end-1995/96, the head of France's grain office ONIC said on Tuesday.

"Total EU grain stocks, public and private, should amount to around 30 million tonnes at end-1996/97 against 25 million at end-1995/96, which should leave intervention stocks of between five and seven million tonnes, but most likely five million tonnes," ONIC director-general Alain Moulinier told a grain conference in the French port city of Rouen.
Moulinier said France initially expected to end the campaign with intervention grain stocks of one million tonnes but the amount could be lower. The campaign ends on June 30.

Moulinier also provided provisional estimates for French soft wheat exports during the current 1996/97 season, putting soft wheat exports to other EU partners at 9.2 million tonnes, including 3.2 million to Italy.
